lesson.title: Wonder as an Antifragile Primer
lesson.topic: Exploring how a sense of wonder can act as a catalyst for personal and intellectual antifragility, encouraging curiosity and resilience in the face of uncertainty.
lesson.steelman: How does fostering a mindset of wonder contribute to one's ability to thrive under unpredictable conditions?
lesson.example: A researcher using a sense of wonder to continuously explore new areas of knowledge, adapting their expertise as fields evolve.

rationale: This lesson bridges the gap between philosophical inquiry and practical resilience, essential for growing a curious yet robust mindset.
